title: Basque Hearty Stew
description: A rich and flavorful stew originating from the Basque region, perfect for a cold winter's day. This hearty stew is loaded with tender beef and vegetables.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Add carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
5. Add beef broth and hearty stew, and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
7. Stir in cheese and cook until melted and bubbly.
8. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
